svg.title: 4K Omarchy frame achieved; Real guest GPU reaches QEMU SDL; repeat fails; backend 4 of 8 stages; desktop product 0 of 4 gates
svg.desc: Real NVIDIA Omarchy wallpaper, bar and application reach QEMU SDL. One 300-frame guest run passes complete source/window pixel and live-cleanup audits. Its repeat fails at frame 207 with device loss. The 4K source is scaled to a 2560 by 1566 SDL backbuffer. The user reports cursor movement and lag. Device-loss diagnosis, frame pacing, normal launcher and automated physical input remain open. Backend stages stay 4 of 8 and product gates stay 0 of 4. Updated October 21, 2026.
